entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [CI triage] Helix monitor reports no submitted jobs on builds with test execution evidence #57340
  • [CI triage] NuGet search escaping test throws Address already in use during HttpListener cleanup on macOS #57339
  • [CI triage] NativeAOT external-command SIGINT test exits 137 instead of 130 on macOS #57338
  • CA5390 / CA5403: ValueContentAnalysis uses unbounded memory on a xorshift generator with a constant seed #57335
  • AffectedTests: any test-assembly change invalidates the map; support per-test invalidation and incremental map updates #57332

Closed

  • CA2241 False negative with C# 14.0 extension() syntax with [StringSyntax] #57259
  • AffectedTests: make the 128 MiB test-map limit configurable (or split the map) #57260
  • Unblock SDK testing on Azure Linux 4 Helix VMs #57208
